changes.before:
Severian's CRIT DMG increases by 30%, and his DMG increases by 12.5%. If there is another Wind character in the squad, his DMG increases by an additional 15%.
When Severian uses Basic Attack: Swift Edge just before being hit by an enemy attack, he can dodge the attack. If he dodges it with any of the first three hits of his Basic Attack, he automatically launches Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind. If he dodges it with the 4th hit, that Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of . This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has Shadowflash and is not invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack that he fails to actively dodge or parry, he consumes 1 stack of Shadowflash to automatically dodge the attack and launch Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Successfully dodging an enemy attack with Basic Attack: Swift Edge, automatically dodging an enemy attack with Shadowflash, or directly dodging an enemy attack all count as a Perfect Dodge.
Shadowflash can stack up to 2 times. If Shadowflash is gained at maximum stacks, gain 1 stack of instead, and the next Basic Attack: Swift Edge is enhanced to Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind.
Each time Severian performs a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of Windborne. While Severian has Windborne and is in combat, press to switch him from off-field to on-field and launch an Entry Skill.
Severian gains by hitting enemies with certain skills or triggering a Perfect Dodge. Flow is capped at 150 points.
When Flow reaches 100 points, hold to consume 100 Flow and launch Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt.

changes.before:
Press to activate:
Launch up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Wind DMG.
When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates 20 .
The 4th attack can dodge enemy attacks at the moment of activation. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to those of Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind, and an additional 15 Flow is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Dodge: Spontaneity during a Basic Attack combo, it does not interrupt the Basic Attackcombo sequence.
